soundness_flags.label: Theorem 4 (least-favorable diameter lower bound)
soundness_flags.one_line: The asymptotic coverage premise only supports a lower bound for all sufficiently large n (and requires measurable random sets), whereas the displayed conclusion has no eventual-n quantifier or measurability condition.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: Theorem 4 / honest_scope
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: The converse is proved only on the explicit covariate-homogeneous least-favorable submodel.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: The lower rate is conditional for every measurable confidence-set procedure honest over any model class containing the stated least-favorable submodel.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: State the lower bound for measurable confidence sets and explicitly quantify it as holding for all sufficiently large n; give the two-point separation and product-TV/KL calculation that fixes the constant and rate.

First solve conditional Poisson likelihood-ratio inversion on the no-covariate least-favorable submodel, then extend it to held-out score cells; this turns the sharp-frontier OEQ into a concrete guard-free upper-bound program.
Anchor the Tian--Wu comparison to its monotonicity EIF and asymptotic-normality theorem, and state precisely which triangular-array sequence violates its fixed-law regular regime.

recommended_next_step: Revise the lower-bound statement’s asymptotic quantifiers and measurability, then advance the field-tier rare-PN coverage and diameter program to Stage 0.
